ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a bimodal distribution of approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels (central interior) and 40% low-intensity black pixels (margins and peduncle).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central regions of the left and right lobes, bifurcated by a vertical low-intensity black band at the axis. Low-intensity black pigmentation defines the leading and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a pixel-depth ratio indicating an angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys that increase in magnitude toward the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Medially concave trailing edge sweep that transitions into a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular dark-pixel annular rings (barnacle scars): four distinct clusters on the left white field and six on the right white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark-pixel linear streaks; a series of vertical marks on the upper-left white quadrant and a prominent diagonal streak in the mid-right white quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, high-texture barnacle colonies localized at the extreme lateral tips and sporadically along the trailing edge peaks.
